title: Concept: Host-based authentication allows every address in postgres — review required
description: In postgres, authentication is offered to every address. pg_hba is the database-side gate, and 0.0.0.0/0 delegates the decision to whatever network path exists. The entry is usually added during a migration and never narrowed once the application subnet is known.
applicability: postgres clusters whose access rules are managed as configuration.
risk: Database exposure to untrusted networks; MEDIUM severity.
